description: A shimmering placeholder that cross-fades to the real content, which rises in out of a blur. While it loads the content is hidden from screen readers and can't be tabbed into.

propDocs.Skeleton.shimmer: Enables the sweeping band; reduced motion keeps it still.
propDocs.SkeletonSwap.loading: Shows the fallback until loading ends.
propDocs.SkeletonSwap.fallback: Placeholder content that shares a grid cell with the loaded content.
propDocs.SkeletonSwap.contentClassName: Classes for the content layer. Its direct children cascade in when loading ends.
